propositions: code-review-verify spec emits {verifications: [...]} output with no decision polarity (FAIL/BLOCK verdict), causing all cases to be scored as advisory regardless of gold label
fidelity_spot_eval._verdict_decision keys only on verdict==FAIL or non-empty findings, neither of which the verifier produces, so it falls through to advisory scoring
The correct fix excludes polarity-free specs from the parity corpus rather than mapping presence of verifications to block, which would incorrectly score the clean-rename case as block
code-review-verify cases (V-real-defect and V-clean-rename) must both emit non-empty verifications per contract, so presence cannot be mapped to polarity
Excluding code-review-verify from parity scoring corrects n_gold from 28 to 26 (above MIN_GOLD_ITEMS floor) and removes symmetric recall miss on both arms without flipping gating verdicts
